For \(n=7\): factors \(1,7\), second largest is \(1 = n-6\). Qualifies.  
For \(n=8\): factors \(1,2,4,8\), second largest is \(4 \neq 2\). Does not qualify.  
For \(n=9\): factors \(1,3,9\), second largest is \(3 = n-6\). Qualifies.  
For \(n=12\): factors \(1,2,3,4,6,12\), second largest is \(6 = n-6\). Qualifies.  

Thus \(C=7+9+12=28\), so \(11C=308\).

\[
\boxed{308}
\]
